title: How do whales breathe?
examples: Do whales need to come up to the surface?
Is it hard for whales to breathe underwater?
What part of the whale do they breathe through?

explain.say: Whales are amazing animals that live in the big ocean.
They do not breathe like fish do at all.
Whales have a special opening on top of their heads.
This opening is called a blowhole when they breathe.
Whales can hold their breath for a very long time.
When they need air, they swim up to the surface to breathe.

faq.q: Do whales breathe through their mouths?
faq.a: No, they do not breathe through their mouths. They use a special hole on top of their heads called a blowhole.
asks: Is the mouth used for breathing?

faq.q: How long can a whale stay underwater?
faq.a: Some whales can hold their breath for a very long time. It depends on the type of whale and how much air they take in.
asks: Can whales hold their breath forever?
What limits how long they stay down?

faq.a: Yes, all whales have this special breathing opening. It is a key part of how they survive in the ocean.
asks: Is the blowhole on all whales?
What is the name of the breathing hole?

faq.q: Do they breathe water or air?
faq.a: Whales must breathe air, just like people do on land. They cannot breathe the water itself.
asks: Do they breathe water like fish?
What kind of gas do they need?

faq.q: Why do they come up to the surface?
faq.a: They must come up to the surface to get enough air to breathe. This is necessary because the water itself is not breathable for them.
asks: What do they do when they are tired of air?

facts: Whales are mammals, meaning they breathe air with lungs.
The blowhole is the specialized breathing opening on the whale's head.
They must surface to take breaths of air.
They can hold their breath for many minutes or even hours.

quiz.say: Whales use which body part to breathe air?
quiz.why: The blowhole is the specific opening whales use to take air from the surface.

wrong.1: This is tempting because we use our mouths to breathe on land.
wrong.2: This is wrong because fins are only used for swimming and steering.
wrong.3: This is wrong because the tail helps them move through the water.

quiz.say: If a whale stays deep underwater, what must it do to breathe?
quiz.why: They must swim up to the surface to reach the air they need to breathe.

wrong.1: This is wrong because the water does not provide enough air for them.
wrong.2: This is wrong because their skin is not designed to take air from the water.
wrong.3: This is wrong because breathing is needed even when they feel strong.

quiz.say: Which statement about whale breathing is correct?

options.show: They breathe water through their gills.
options.say: They breathe water through their gills.

options.show: They breathe only when they are tired.
options.say: They breathe only when they are tired.

options.show: They breathe only in shallow water.
options.say: They breathe only in shallow water.

quiz.why: Whales are mammals, so they breathe air using lungs, not gills like fish.

wrong.0: This is wrong because only fish use gills to extract oxygen from water.
wrong.1: This is wrong because they must breathe regularly to survive.
wrong.2: This is wrong because they can breathe at various depths if they surface.
